#### Lagged confidence → deliberation

For each scenario we extract the per-function chunk-dev slopes of lagged confidence (n − 1 only; n − 1 and n − 2 from the joint model), apply BH within scenario × spec (matching the main analysis), and lay them out in one wide table per outcome (activation, intensity). Cells show the slope estimate with a significance star from the BH-corrected p-value.

```{r chunk-118 }
# stack per-scenario slope tables for one model family
gather_chunk_dev_slopes <- function(model_name_n1, model_name_both) {
  robustness_fits %>%
    mutate(slopes = map(fit, function(f) {
      bind_rows(
        get_slope_table(f[[model_name_n1]],   "lag_conf_chunk_dev_1", "n−1 only",  "Chunk dev (n−1)"),
        get_slope_table(f[[model_name_both]], "lag_conf_chunk_dev_1", "n−1 + n−2", "Chunk dev (n−1)"),
        get_slope_table(f[[model_name_both]], "lag_conf_chunk_dev_2", "n−1 + n−2", "Chunk dev (n−2)")
      )
    })) %>%
    select(scenario = label, slopes) %>%
    unnest(slopes) %>%
    mutate(scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_levels)) %>%
    group_by(scenario) %>%
    group_modify(~ add_fdr(.x)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# wide flextable: rows = (Function, Component); columns = β with stars per scenario
compact_compare_table <- function(long_df, row_vars, value_col, caption) {
  scen <- as.character(scenario_levels)
  long_df %>%
    mutate(cell = sprintf("%.3f%s", .data[[value_col]], signif)) %>%
    select(all_of(row_vars), scenario, cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = scenario, values_from = cell) %>%
    arrange(across(all_of(row_vars))) %>%
    select(all_of(row_vars), all_of(scen)) %>%
    flextable() %>%
    flextable::theme_apa() %>%
    align(j = scen, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
    set_caption(caption)
}
```

#### Lagged deliberation → confidence

Same idea on the reverse direction. For each scenario we pull the chunk-dev deliberation coefficients on confidence, apply BH within scenario × spec, and report β with significance stars.

```{r chunk-121 }
# per-function chunk-dev coefficients on confidence (within-trial effects)
get_conf_delib_chunk_dev <- function(model, model_label) {
  broom::tidy(model, parametric = TRUE) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "_chunk_dev_[12]$")) %>%
    mutate(
      Model = model_label,
      Predictor = case_when(
        str_detect(term, "control")       ~ "Control",
        str_detect(term, "generation")    ~ "Generation",
        str_detect(term, "justification") ~ "Justification",
        str_detect(term, "regulation")    ~ "Regulation"
      ),
      Component = if_else(str_detect(term, "_chunk_dev_1$"),
                          "Chunk dev (n−1)", "Chunk dev (n−2)")
    ) %>%
    select(Model, Predictor, Component,
           Estimate = estimate,
           SE       = std.error,
           p.value)
}

# stack per-scenario chunk-dev deliberation coefficients on confidence
gather_delib_chunk_dev <- function() {
  robustness_fits %>%
    mutate(coefs = map(fit, function(f) {
      bind_rows(
        get_conf_delib_chunk_dev(f$delib_n1,   "n−1 only"),
        get_conf_delib_chunk_dev(f$delib_both, "n−1 + n−2")
      )
    })) %>%
    select(scenario = label, coefs) %>%
    unnest(coefs) %>%
    mutate(scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenario_levels)) %>%
    group_by(scenario, Model) %>%
    mutate(
      `p (BH)` = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
      signif = case_when(
        `p (BH)` < 0.001 ~ "***",
        `p (BH)` < 0.01  ~ "**",
        `p (BH)` < 0.05  ~ "*",
        `p (BH)` < 0.1   ~ ".",
        TRUE             ~ ""
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

delib_chunk_dev_rob <- gather_delib_chunk_dev()
```

### Recovery analysis with synthetic effects

We test how the lagged-confidence pipeline behaves when the truth is known. For each scenario, we regenerate the relevant outcome from a reduced baseline model that preserves the empirical structure of the data, inject a known chunk-dev (n−1) effect on the link scale, refit the final n−1 models, and check what comes back. This gives power for affected cells and the false-positive rate for unaffected cells in the same framework.

We use three scenarios with disjoint function sets, so no function is touched twice in any scenario. In **conf → delib only**, low chunk-dev confidence at n−1 increases activation for Generation and Justification; Control and Regulation are null. In **delib → conf only**, chunk-dev deliberation at n−1 increases confidence for Control and Regulation; Generation and Justification are null. In **mutual**, both injections run simultaneously.

The reduced baselines retain subject and question effects, trajectory structure, trial- and subject-level confidence, and autoregressive structure. For activation and confidence, the AR controls are recomputed from the regenerated outcomes before refitting. Detection rates use both raw `p < .05` and BH-corrected p-values within each scenario × iteration × model.


```{r chunk-125 }
n_iter  <- 100
beta_cd <- -0.30
beta_dc <-  0.20
nthreads_recovery      <- n_cores

# disjoint function sets so the mutual scenario reaches all four without overlap
funcs_cd  <- c("Generation", "Justification")
funcs_dc  <- c("Control", "Regulation")
scenarios <- c("conf → delib only", "delib → conf only", "mutual")

# truth value per scenario × model × function
get_truth <- function(scenario, Model, fn) {
  case_when(
    Model %in% c("Activation hurdle") &
      scenario %in% c("conf → delib only", "mutual") &
      fn %in% funcs_cd ~ beta_cd,
    Model == "Confidence beta" &
      scenario %in% c("delib → conf only", "mutual") &
      fn %in% funcs_dc ~ beta_dc,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )
}
```

The reduced baselines drop only the chunk-dev (n−1) terms we want to test. Predictions from these models give the empirical structure onto which we add the synthetic effect.

```{r chunk-126 }
refit_synth_baselines <- FALSE

synth_hurdle_baseline <- fit_or_load(
  path  = "./Output/Saved_models/synth_hurdle_baseline_n1.rds",
  refit = refit_synth_baselines,
  fit_fun = function() {
    bam(
      active ~ deliberation_function +
        deliberation_function * conf_trial_dev +
        deliberation_function * conf_subject_mean +
        deliberation_function * lag_active_1 +
        s(norm_mid, by = deliberation_function, k = 10) +
        s(subject_id, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
        s(question, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
        s(trial_id, bs = "re"),
      family = binomial(link = "logit"),
      data   = chunks_long_conf_n1,
      method = "fREML", discrete = TRUE, nthreads = nthreads_recovery
    )
  }
)

synth_conf_baseline <- fit_or_load(
  path  = "./Output/Saved_models/synth_conf_baseline_n1.rds",
  refit = refit_synth_baselines,
  fit_fun = function() {
    bam(
      confidence_01 ~ lag_confidence_1 +
        control_trial_dev       + control_subject_mean +
        generation_trial_dev    + generation_subject_mean +
        justification_trial_dev + justification_subject_mean +
        regulation_trial_dev    + regulation_subject_mean +
        s(norm_mid, k = 10) +
        s(subject_id, bs = "re") +
        s(question,   bs = "re"),
      family = betar(link = "logit"),
      data   = chunks_conf_delib_n1,
      method = "fREML", discrete = TRUE, nthreads = nthreads_recovery
    )
  }
)

# beta precision estimated from the observed bounded outcomes
phi_conf <- synth_conf_baseline$family$getTheta(TRUE)
```

Each helper regenerates one outcome from its reduced baseline, adds the scenario-specific effect, and recomputes any AR lag that depends on the regenerated outcome.

```{r chunk-127 }
# regenerate active and recompute lag_active_1
inject_active <- function(df, scenario) {
  inject_funcs <- if (scenario %in% c("conf → delib only", "mutual")) funcs_cd else character(0)

  df %>%
    mutate(
      .lp    = predict(synth_hurdle_baseline, newdata = ., type = "link") +
                 if_else(as.character(deliberation_function) %in% inject_funcs,
                         beta_cd, 0) * lag_conf_chunk_dev_1,
      active = rbinom(n(), 1, plogis(.lp))
    ) %>%
    arrange(subject_id, question, deliberation_function, chunk_id) %>%
    group_by(subject_id, question, deliberation_function) %>%
    mutate(.lag = lag(active, 1)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(lag_active_1 = factor(.lag, levels = c(0, 1),
                                 labels = c("Inactive", "Active"))) %>%
    select(-.lp, -.lag) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lag_active_1))
}


# regenerate confidence_01 and recompute lag_confidence_1
inject_confidence_01 <- function(df, scenario) {
  inject_funcs <- if (scenario %in% c("delib → conf only", "mutual")) funcs_dc else character(0)
  e <- function(f) if (f %in% inject_funcs) beta_dc else 0

  df %>%
    mutate(
      .injection = e("Control")       * lag_control_chunk_dev_1 +
                   e("Generation")    * lag_generation_chunk_dev_1 +
                   e("Justification") * lag_justification_chunk_dev_1 +
                   e("Regulation")    * lag_regulation_chunk_dev_1,
      .mu = plogis(predict(synth_conf_baseline, newdata = ., type = "link") + .injection),
      confidence_01 = pmax(eps, pmin(1 - eps,
                                     rbeta(n(), .mu * phi_conf, (1 - .mu) * phi_conf)))
    ) %>%
    mutate(.conf_z = as.numeric(scale(confidence_01))) %>%
    arrange(subject_id, question, chunk_id) %>%
    group_by(subject_id, question) %>%
    mutate(lag_confidence_1 = lag(.conf_z, 1)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-.injection, -.mu, -.conf_z) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lag_confidence_1))
}
```

```{r chunk-128 }
# regenerate outcomes for one scenario, refit the n−1 models, return chunk-dev slopes
run_synthesis_once <- function(scenario) {
  long_synth  <- inject_active(chunks_long_conf_n1, scenario)
  chunk_synth <- inject_confidence_01(chunks_conf_delib_n1, scenario)

  fit_hurdle <- bam(
    active ~ deliberation_function * lag_conf_chunk_dev_1 +
      deliberation_function * conf_trial_dev +
      deliberation_function * conf_subject_mean +
      deliberation_function * lag_active_1 +
      s(norm_mid, by = deliberation_function, k = 10) +
      s(subject_id, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
      s(question, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
      s(trial_id, bs = "re"),
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    data   = long_synth,
    method = "fREML", discrete = TRUE, nthreads = nthreads_recovery
  )

  fit_conf <- bam(
    confidence_01 ~ lag_confidence_1 +
      lag_control_chunk_dev_1       + control_trial_dev       + control_subject_mean +
      lag_generation_chunk_dev_1    + generation_trial_dev    + generation_subject_mean +
      lag_justification_chunk_dev_1 + justification_trial_dev + justification_subject_mean +
      lag_regulation_chunk_dev_1    + regulation_trial_dev    + regulation_subject_mean +
      s(norm_mid, k = 10) +
      s(subject_id, bs = "re") +
      s(question,   bs = "re"),
    family = betar(link = "logit"),
    data   = chunk_synth,
    method = "fREML", discrete = TRUE, nthreads = nthreads_recovery
  )

  slopes_hurdle <- emtrends(fit_hurdle, ~ deliberation_function,
                            var = "lag_conf_chunk_dev_1") %>%
    summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    transmute(Model    = "Activation hurdle",
              Function = as.character(deliberation_function),
              estimate = lag_conf_chunk_dev_1.trend,
              SE, p.value)

  coefs_conf <- broom::tidy(fit_conf, parametric = TRUE) %>%
    filter(str_detect(term, "_chunk_dev_1$")) %>%
    transmute(
      Model    = "Confidence beta",
      Function = case_when(
        str_detect(term, "control")       ~ "Control",
        str_detect(term, "generation")    ~ "Generation",
        str_detect(term, "justification") ~ "Justification",
        str_detect(term, "regulation")    ~ "Regulation"
      ),
      estimate, SE = std.error, p.value
    )

    bind_rows(slopes_hurdle, coefs_conf)
}
```

We run 100 iterations per scenario, sequentially so `bam()` can use threads inside each fit. The result is cached.

```{r chunk-129 }
refit_synth_results <- FALSE

iter_grid <- expand_grid(scenario = scenarios,
                         iter     = seq_len(n_iter))

synth_results <- fit_or_load(
  path  = "./Output/Saved_models/synth_results.rds",
  refit = refit_synth_results,
  fit_fun = function() {
    plan(sequential)

    raw <- with_progress({
      p <- progressr::progressor(steps = nrow(iter_grid))
      pmap_dfr(iter_grid, function(scenario, iter) {
        set.seed(2025 + iter + match(scenario, scenarios) * 10000)
        out <- run_synthesis_once(scenario) %>%
          mutate(scenario = scenario, iter = iter)
        p(message = sprintf("%s / iteration %d", scenario, iter))
        out
      })
    })

    raw %>%
      group_by(scenario, iter, Model) %>%
      mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(truth             = get_truth(scenario, Model, Function),
             has_true_effect   = truth != 0,
             correct_direction = truth == 0 | sign(estimate) == sign(truth),
             Model    = factor(Model,
                               levels = c("Activation hurdle",
                                          "Confidence beta")),
             scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenarios))
  }
)
```

Detection rate is power when the truth is non-zero and the false-positive rate when the truth is zero. BH is applied within model across the four functions per scenario × iteration.

```{r chunk-130 }
synth_summary <- synth_results %>%
  group_by(scenario, Model, Function, truth, has_true_effect) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_estimate   = mean(estimate),
    ci_lower        = quantile(estimate, 0.025),
    ci_upper        = quantile(estimate, 0.975),
    detect_rate_raw = mean((p.value < 0.05) & correct_direction),
    detect_rate_bh  = mean((p_bh    < 0.05) & correct_direction),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(metric = if_else(has_true_effect, "Power", "False-positive rate")) %>%
  arrange(scenario, Model, Function)

kable(synth_summary, digits = 3,
      caption = sprintf("Recovery over %d iterations per scenario. Detection rate is power when truth ≠ 0 and false-positive rate when truth = 0.", n_iter))
```

### Common-cause simulation

A different concern: the lagged effects might be artefacts of an unobserved state shared by confidence and deliberation. Things like uncertainty, conflict, engagement, fatigue, or fluency could push both quantities at the same time. If that state is autocorrelated, confidence at chunk n−1 will look like it predicts deliberation at chunk n even with no direct link between them.

We test this with a simple generative simulation. The trial structure is the empirical one — same participants, questions, trials, chunks, normalized positions. Within each trial, a latent uncertainty state follows an AR(1) process. Confidence loads negatively on this state (more uncertainty, lower confidence) and deliberation loads positively (more uncertainty, more deliberation activation). Both are tied to the same latent state, but no direct lagged link exists between them.

The calibration parameters are ρ = .50, λ_conf = .50, λ_act = .50, σ_conf = .80, picked from a coarse grid to give moderate raw lag/lead coupling close to the empirical nuisance level. When injected, the true signal is β = −.30 on the logit scale: lower confidence at n−1 increases the probability of activation at n.

We run two conditions. The shared-state-only condition has the true effect set to zero everywhere. The true-lagged-signal condition injects β = −.30 for Control, Generation, and Justification, with Regulation kept at zero as a within-condition negative control. We refit the same n−1 activation hurdle and read off the per-function chunk-dev slopes.

Before fitting anything, we look at empirical lag/lead correlations between confidence and average deliberation. A pure shared-state process should give roughly symmetric lag and lead correlations. A directional process should give stronger past-confidence than future-confidence coupling.

```{r chunk-132 }
core_function_levels <- c("Control", "Generation", "Justification", "Regulation")

# pooled empirical raw and chunk-dev lag/lead correlations between confidence and average deliberation
empirical_diag_full <- chunks_scored_clean %>%
  arrange(subject_id, question, chunk_id) %>%
  mutate(confidence_z = as.numeric(scale(response_confidence)),
         core_mean    = rowMeans(across(all_of(core_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
         core_mean_z  = as.numeric(scale(core_mean))) %>%
  group_by(subject_id, question) %>%
  mutate(lag_conf_raw   = lag(confidence_z, 1),
         lead_conf_raw  = lead(confidence_z, 1),
         conf_chunk_dev = confidence_z - mean(confidence_z, na.rm = TRUE),
         core_chunk_dev = core_mean_z  - mean(core_mean_z,  na.rm = TRUE),
         lag_conf_dev   = lag(conf_chunk_dev, 1),
         lead_conf_dev  = lead(conf_chunk_dev, 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(raw_lag  = cor(lag_conf_raw,  core_mean_z,    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
            raw_lead = cor(lead_conf_raw, core_mean_z,    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
            dev_lag  = cor(lag_conf_dev,  core_chunk_dev, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
            dev_lead = cor(lead_conf_dev, core_chunk_dev, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
```

The toy data generator builds the latent state, draws confidence and activation from it, and applies the optional injected effect on the affected functions.

```{r chunk-133 }
# trial structure mirrors the real data
sim_structure <- chunks_scored_clean %>%
  distinct(subject_id, question, trial_id, chunk_id, norm_mid) %>%
  arrange(subject_id, question, chunk_id) %>%
  mutate(subject_id = factor(subject_id),
         question   = factor(question),
         trial_id   = factor(trial_id))

# AR(1) latent state, normalised so its sd is 1 within each call
make_ar_state <- function(n, rho) {
  e <- rnorm(n, 0, sqrt(1 - rho^2))
  x <- numeric(n)
  x[1] <- rnorm(1)
  if (n > 1) {
    for (i in seq_len(n - 1)) x[i + 1] <- rho * x[i] + e[i + 1]
  }
  x
}

# baseline activation rates per function from the real data
sim_baselines <- chunks_long_conf_n1 %>%
  group_by(deliberation_function) %>%
  summarise(intercept = qlogis(mean(active)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(deliberation_function = factor(deliberation_function,
                                        levels = core_function_levels))

# generative model: confidence and each deliberation function depend contemporaneously
# on the latent state. only affected functions also depend on lagged chunk-dev confidence
# in the signal condition.
simulate_toy <- function(structure   = sim_structure,
                         rho         = 0.50,
                         lambda_conf = 0.50,
                         lambda_act  = 0.50,
                         sigma_conf  = 0.80,
                         signal_size = -0.30,
                         affected    = c("Control", "Generation", "Justification")) {
  structure %>%
    group_by(trial_id) %>%
    mutate(latent       = make_ar_state(n(), rho)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(confidence_z = -lambda_conf * latent + rnorm(n(), 0, sigma_conf)) %>%
    arrange(subject_id, question, chunk_id) %>%
    group_by(subject_id, question) %>%
    mutate(conf_chunk_dev        = confidence_z - mean(confidence_z, na.rm = TRUE),
           lag_conf_chunk_dev_1  = lag(conf_chunk_dev, 1),
           lead_conf_chunk_dev_1 = lead(conf_chunk_dev, 1)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(subject_id) %>%
    mutate(conf_subject_mean = mean(confidence_z, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    group_by(subject_id, question) %>%
    mutate(conf_trial_dev = mean(confidence_z, na.rm = TRUE) - conf_subject_mean) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    crossing(sim_baselines) %>%
    mutate(
      signal_term = if_else(deliberation_function %in% affected & !is.na(lag_conf_chunk_dev_1),
                            signal_size * lag_conf_chunk_dev_1, 0),
      lp          = intercept + lambda_act * latent + signal_term,
      active      = rbinom(n(), 1, plogis(lp))
    ) %>%
    arrange(subject_id, question, deliberation_function, chunk_id) %>%
    group_by(subject_id, question, deliberation_function) %>%
    mutate(lag_active_1 = lag(active, 1)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(lag_active_1 = factor(lag_active_1, levels = c(0, 1),
                                 labels = c("Inactive", "Active"))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lag_conf_chunk_dev_1), !is.na(lag_active_1)) %>%
    mutate(deliberation_function = factor(deliberation_function,
                                          levels = core_function_levels))
}
```

We compute lag and lead correlations on simulated null datasets and put them next to the empirical values. If the toy model captures the shared-state mechanism at the right strength, simulated lag and lead should be close in magnitude and broadly comparable to the empirical lead.

```{r chunk-134 }
calibration_diag_full <- map_dfr(seq_len(20), function(i) {
  set.seed(2026 + i)
  
  simulate_toy(signal_size = 0) %>%
    group_by(subject_id, question, chunk_id) %>%
    summarise(confidence_z  = first(confidence_z),
              active_mean   = mean(active),
              lag_conf_dev  = first(lag_conf_chunk_dev_1),
              lead_conf_dev = first(lead_conf_chunk_dev_1),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(subject_id, question, chunk_id) %>%
    group_by(subject_id, question) %>%
    mutate(lag_conf_raw     = lag(confidence_z, 1),
           lead_conf_raw    = lead(confidence_z, 1),
           active_chunk_dev = active_mean - mean(active_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    summarise(iter     = i,
              raw_lag  = cor(lag_conf_raw, active_mean, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
              raw_lead = cor(lead_conf_raw, active_mean, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
              dev_lag  = cor(lag_conf_dev, active_chunk_dev, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
              dev_lead = cor(lead_conf_dev, active_chunk_dev, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
})

calibration_table <- bind_rows(
  empirical_diag_full %>%
    mutate(source = "Empirical"),
  calibration_diag_full %>%
    summarise(across(c(raw_lag, raw_lead, dev_lag, dev_lead),
                     ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
    mutate(source = "Shared-state simulation")
) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(raw_lag, raw_lead, dev_lag, dev_lead),
               names_to = "diagnostic",
               values_to = "correlation") %>%
  mutate(diagnostic = recode(diagnostic,
                             raw_lag = "Raw lag",
                             raw_lead = "Raw lead",
                             dev_lag = "Chunk-dev lag",
                             dev_lead = "Chunk-dev lead"),
         diagnostic = factor(diagnostic,
                             levels = c("Raw lag", "Raw lead",
                                        "Chunk-dev lag", "Chunk-dev lead"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source,
              values_from = correlation)

kable(calibration_table,
      digits = 3,
      caption = "Empirical and simulated lag/lead correlations. Raw uses confidence and deliberation directly; chunk-dev uses within-trial deviations.")
```

To make the simulation easier to understand, here is a long single trial showing the latent state, confidence, and average deliberation under the null model (shared state only) and under the model with the injected lagged effect. Latent and confidence are identical between models by construction. Deliberation diverges visibly when low confidence at n−1 boosts deliberation at n.

```{r chunk-135 }
set.seed(2027)

long_structure <- tibble(subject_id = factor("sim_subject"),
                         question   = factor("sim_question"),
                         trial_id   = factor("sim_trial"),
                         chunk_id   = seq_len(40),
                         norm_mid   = seq(0, 1, length.out = 40))

# longer paired trajectories: same latent and confidence in both models, only the lagged effect differs
simulate_paired_long <- function(structure   = long_structure,
                                 rho         = 0.50,
                                 lambda_conf = 0.50,
                                 lambda_act  = 0.50,
                                 sigma_conf  = 0.80,
                                 signal_size = -0.30) {
  base_wide <- structure %>%
    group_by(trial_id) %>%
    mutate(latent = make_ar_state(n(), rho)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(conf_noise   = rnorm(n()),
           confidence_z = -lambda_conf * latent + sigma_conf * conf_noise) %>%
    arrange(subject_id, question, chunk_id) %>%
    group_by(subject_id, question) %>%
    mutate(conf_chunk_dev       = confidence_z - mean(confidence_z, na.rm = TRUE),
           lag_conf_chunk_dev_1 = lag(conf_chunk_dev, 1)) %>%
    ungroup()

  # same activation noise reused in both models so only the lagged effect differs
  sim_noise <- base_wide %>%
    crossing(sim_baselines) %>%
    mutate(act_noise = rnorm(n()))

  sim_noise %>%
    crossing(model = factor(c("Null model", "Confidence-deliberation model"),
                            levels = c("Null model", "Confidence-deliberation model"))) %>%
    mutate(signal_term = if_else(model == "Confidence-deliberation model" &
                                   deliberation_function %in% c("Control", "Generation", "Justification") &
                                   !is.na(lag_conf_chunk_dev_1),
                                 signal_size * lag_conf_chunk_dev_1, 0),
           lp          = intercept + lambda_act * latent + signal_term + 0.25 * act_noise,
           active_prob = plogis(lp)) %>%
    group_by(model, subject_id, question, trial_id, chunk_id) %>%
    summarise(latent       = first(latent),
              confidence_z = first(confidence_z),
              deliberation = mean(active_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(deliberation_z = as.numeric(scale(deliberation)))
}

sim_long_panel <- simulate_paired_long() %>%
  pivot_longer(c(latent, confidence_z, deliberation_z),
               names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(measure = recode(measure,
                          latent         = "Uncertainty",
                          confidence_z   = "Confidence",
                          deliberation_z = "Deliberation"),
         measure = factor(measure,
                          levels = c("Uncertainty", "Confidence", "Deliberation")))

p_common_cause_paired <- ggplot(sim_long_panel,
                                aes(x = chunk_id, y = value,
                                    color = model, linetype = model, group = model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x,
              se = FALSE, span = 0.07, linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Null model"                    = "black",
                                "Confidence-deliberation model" = "#0072B2"),
                     labels = c("Null model"                    = "Shared state only",
                                "Confidence-deliberation model" = "Shared state + lagged effect")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Null model"                    = "solid",
                                   "Confidence-deliberation model" = "dashed"),
                        labels = c("Null model"                    = "Shared state only",
                                   "Confidence-deliberation model" = "Shared state + lagged effect")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 40, by = 10)) +
  labs(x = "Chunk", y = "Standardized value",
       color = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
  jtools::theme_apa() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold"))

p_common_cause_paired

ggsave("./Output/Robustness_analyses/Lagged_confidence_deliberation/common_cause_paired_trajectory_panel.svg",
       plot = p_common_cause_paired, dpi = 600,
       width = fig_size_long[["width"]],
       height = fig_size_long[["height"]])
```

The pipeline runner refits the final n−1 activation hurdle on each simulated dataset and pulls the per-function chunk-dev slopes, applying BH within model. Each `bam()` call uses all available cores via `nthreads`; iterations run sequentially to avoid oversubscription.

```{r chunk-136 }
# refit the final n−1 activation hurdle, return per-function chunk-dev slopes
fit_toy_pipeline <- function(sim_data) {
  fit <- bam(
    active ~ deliberation_function * lag_conf_chunk_dev_1 +
      deliberation_function * conf_trial_dev +
      deliberation_function * conf_subject_mean +
      deliberation_function * lag_active_1 +
      s(norm_mid, by = deliberation_function, k = 10) +
      s(subject_id, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
      s(question, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
      s(trial_id, bs = "re"),
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    data   = sim_data,
    method = "fREML", discrete = TRUE, nthreads = n_cores
  )

  emtrends(fit, ~ deliberation_function, var = "lag_conf_chunk_dev_1") %>%
    summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    transmute(Function = as.character(deliberation_function),
              estimate = lag_conf_chunk_dev_1.trend,
              SE, p.value) %>%
    mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))
}
```

We run 100 iterations per condition. The result is cached.

```{r chunk-137 }
refit_cc_results <- FALSE
n_iter_cc        <- 100

cc_results <- fit_or_load(
  path  = "./Output/Saved_models/cc_results.rds",
  refit = refit_cc_results,
  fit_fun = function() {
    iter_grid_cc <- expand_grid(
      condition = c("shared latent state only", "true lagged signal"),
      iter      = seq_len(n_iter_cc)
    )

    pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(iter_grid_cc), style = 3)

    out <- pmap_dfr(iter_grid_cc, function(condition, iter) {
      set.seed(2025 + iter + 1000 * (condition == "true lagged signal"))
      sim_data <- simulate_toy(
        signal_size = if (condition == "true lagged signal") -0.30 else 0
      )
      r <- fit_toy_pipeline(sim_data) %>%
        mutate(condition = condition, iter = iter)
      setTxtProgressBar(pb, which(iter_grid_cc$condition == condition &
                                  iter_grid_cc$iter      == iter))
      r
    })

    close(pb)
    out
  }
)
```

In the null condition the truth is zero everywhere, so the detection rate is the FPR. In the signal condition the truth is −0.30 for Control, Generation, Justification, and zero for Regulation as a within-condition negative control.

```{r chunk-138 }
cc_summary <- cc_results %>%
  mutate(
    truth             = case_when(
      condition == "true lagged signal" &
        Function %in% c("Control", "Generation", "Justification") ~ -0.30,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    correct_direction = truth == 0 | sign(estimate) == sign(truth),
    detected          = (p_bh < 0.05) & correct_direction
  ) %>%
  group_by(condition, Function, truth) %>%
  summarise(mean_estimate = mean(estimate),
            ci_lower      = quantile(estimate, 0.025),
            ci_upper      = quantile(estimate, 0.975),
            detect_rate   = mean(detected),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(condition, Function)

kable(cc_summary, digits = 3,
      caption = sprintf("Common-cause simulation: per-function chunk-dev (n−1) recovery across %d iterations per condition. detect_rate is the FPR when truth = 0 and power when truth ≠ 0.", n_iter_cc))
```

#### Ablation: which feature protects against false inferences?

Here we want to know which feature of the model is doing the work. We refit the simulation under four reduced variants, each removing one protective feature: no AR control on past activation, raw lagged confidence in place of the chunk-dev decomposition, no trial_id random intercept, and no smooth on `norm_mid`. If a feature carries real protective weight, removing it should inflate the false-positive rate under shared-state coupling.

```{r chunk-140 }
n_iter_variant <- 30
variants       <- c("no AR", "no chunk-dev", "no trial_id", "no norm_mid smooth")

# build the formula and predictor variable for each variant
variant_spec <- function(variant) {
  switch(variant,
    "no AR" = list(
      pred = "lag_conf_chunk_dev_1",
      form = active ~ deliberation_function * lag_conf_chunk_dev_1 +
                      deliberation_function * conf_trial_dev +
                      deliberation_function * conf_subject_mean +
                      s(norm_mid, by = deliberation_function, k = 10) +
                      s(subject_id, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
                      s(question, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
                      s(trial_id, bs = "re")
    ),
    "no chunk-dev" = list(
      pred = "lag_conf_raw_1",
      form = active ~ deliberation_function * lag_conf_raw_1 +
                      deliberation_function * lag_active_1 +
                      s(norm_mid, by = deliberation_function, k = 10) +
                      s(subject_id, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
                      s(question, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
                      s(trial_id, bs = "re")
    ),
    "no trial_id" = list(
      pred = "lag_conf_chunk_dev_1",
      form = active ~ deliberation_function * lag_conf_chunk_dev_1 +
                      deliberation_function * conf_trial_dev +
                      deliberation_function * conf_subject_mean +
                      deliberation_function * lag_active_1 +
                      s(norm_mid, by = deliberation_function, k = 10) +
                      s(subject_id, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
                      s(question, deliberation_function, bs = "re")
    ),
    "no norm_mid smooth" = list(
      pred = "lag_conf_chunk_dev_1",
      form = active ~ deliberation_function * lag_conf_chunk_dev_1 +
                      deliberation_function * conf_trial_dev +
                      deliberation_function * conf_subject_mean +
                      deliberation_function * lag_active_1 +
                      s(subject_id, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
                      s(question, deliberation_function, bs = "re") +
                      s(trial_id, bs = "re")
    )
  )
}

# refit one variant on one simulated dataset
fit_toy_variant <- function(sim_data, variant) {
  spec <- variant_spec(variant)

  model_data <- sim_data %>%
    arrange(subject_id, question, deliberation_function, chunk_id) %>%
    group_by(subject_id, question, deliberation_function) %>%
    mutate(lag_conf_raw_1 = lag(confidence_z, 1)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[spec$pred]]), !is.na(lag_active_1))

  fit <- bam(spec$form,
             family = binomial(link = "logit"),
             data   = model_data,
             method = "fREML", discrete = TRUE, nthreads = n_cores)

  emtrends(fit, ~ deliberation_function, var = spec$pred) %>%
    summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    transmute(Function = as.character(deliberation_function),
              estimate = .data[[paste0(spec$pred, ".trend")]],
              SE, p.value, variant = variant) %>%
    mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))
}

# run all variants × conditions × iterations, cached
refit_cc_variant_results <- FALSE

cc_variant_results <- fit_or_load(
  path  = "./Output/Saved_models/cc_variant_results.rds",
  refit = refit_cc_variant_results,
  fit_fun = function() {
    variant_grid <- expand_grid(
      condition = c("shared latent state only", "true lagged signal"),
      variant   = variants,
      iter      = seq_len(n_iter_variant)
    )

    pb_variant <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(variant_grid), style = 3)

    out <- pmap_dfr(variant_grid, function(condition, variant, iter) {
      set.seed(4025 + iter + 1000 * (condition == "true lagged signal"))
      sim_data <- simulate_toy(
        signal_size = if (condition == "true lagged signal") -0.30 else 0
      )
      r <- fit_toy_variant(sim_data, variant) %>%
        mutate(condition = condition, iter = iter)
      setTxtProgressBar(pb_variant,
                        which(variant_grid$condition == condition &
                              variant_grid$variant   == variant &
                              variant_grid$iter      == iter))
      r
    })

    close(pb_variant)
    out
  }
)
```
